name: Little Rock Truck Parts
old_description: Founded in 2009, Little Rock Truck Parts strives to be a leader in the diesel engine and truck parts industry. That is why we keep a large inventory of used diesel engine parts like Detroit Diesel, Cummins, Caterpillar, and more. We also have many trucks and truck parts available for brands like Freightliner, Peterbilt, Kenworth, Western Star and more.
about:
Little Rock Truck Parts was founded in 2009 in North Little Rock, Arkansas. The company operates as a distributor and service provider for heavy-duty truck and diesel engine components.

The business maintains a large inventory of used diesel engine parts from manufacturers such as Detroit Diesel, Cummins, and Caterpillar, as well as truck parts for brands including Freightliner, Peterbilt, Kenworth, Western Star, and International. It also operates as a dealer for Interstate-McBee, supplying in-frame kits and other engine components. In addition to parts sales, the company offers custom rear-end and transmission repair services for Freightliner, Kenworth, and International trucks. A recent acquisition added several hundred used Detroit engines covering series from 2-53 through 16V149, 60 Series, and MTU 2000 and 4000 models. Export services with special pricing are available for international customers.

Little Rock Truck Parts serves retail, wholesale, and export customers in the heavy-duty trucking and diesel engine repair sectors. Its customer base includes fleets, repair shops, and overseas buyers seeking used engines, transmissions, and drivetrain components.

The company states that it strives to be a leader in the diesel engine and truck parts industry by maintaining extensive stock and offering guaranteed quality on every part sold.
